power.jaymospowers.gravity.desc: Take the weight out of things, or pile it on. Lift creatures, float yourself, pull and crush.
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_1: Hold: Lift. Right click: choke it; again: slam it down
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.ability_2: Gravity Well (pull everything to a point)
message.jaymospowers.gravity_ascend.0: Everything you drop falls a little further.
message.jaymospowers.gravity_ascend.1: The ground feels very far below you now.
message.jaymospowers.gravity_cure_hint: For a moment, something else carries the weight...
power.jaymospowers.gravity.key.starter: Hold: Lift (weightless where you point). Small things drift toward you; you jump a little higher
